# Directional Snake Body — Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Replace disconnected blob body segments with direction-aware sprites (head/straight/corner/tail) that rotate based on segment connectivity, creating a visually continuous snake.

**Architecture:** 4 base sprites generated by SpriteGeneratorEditor + runtime rotation in SnakeController.UpdateSegmentVisuals(). Each segment calculates its direction from neighbor positions, picks the correct sprite, and rotates accordingly.

**Tech Stack:** Unity C#, SpriteRenderer, procedural Texture2D generation

- [ ] **Step 1: Add GenerateBodyStraight method**

Insert after the existing `GenerateSnakeBody()` method:

```csharp
private void GenerateBodyStraight(string path)
{
    Texture2D tex = CreateTexture(pixelSize, pixelSize);
    Color[] pixels = new Color[pixelSize * pixelSize];

    int half = pixelSize / 2;
    float bodyHalfH = pixelSize * 0.22f;    // half height (thinner than blob)
    float cornerR = pixelSize * 0.12f;       // corner radius for rounded ends

    for (int y = 0; y < pixelSize; y++)
    {
        for (int x = 0; x < pixelSize; x++)
        {
            float cx = x - half;
            float cy = Mathf.Abs(y - half);
            bool inside = false;

            if (x < cornerR || x >= pixelSize - cornerR)
            {
                // Rounded ends (left and right edges)
                float cornerCx = (x < cornerR) ? cornerR - x : x - (pixelSize - cornerR - 1);
                float cornerCy = cy - (bodyHalfH - cornerR);
                if (cornerCy < 0f)
                    inside = cy <= bodyHalfH;
                else
                    inside = (cornerCx * cornerCx + cornerCy * cornerCy) <= (cornerR * cornerR);
            }
            else
            {
                inside = cy <= bodyHalfH;
            }

            if (inside)
            {
                pixels[y * pixelSize + x] = snakeBodyColor;

                // Body pattern (diamond spots)
                float patternScale = 0.12f;
                int px = (int)(cx * patternScale);
                int py = (int)((y - half) * patternScale);
                if ((px + py) % 3 == 0 && Mathf.Abs(cx) < half * 0.7f)
                {
                    float pd = Mathf.Abs(cx * 0.06f) + Mathf.Abs((y - half) * 0.12f);
                    if (pd < 0.5f)
                        pixels[y * pixelSize + x] = snakeBodyPatternColor;
                }

                // Edge highlight
                if (cy > bodyHalfH - 3f)
                    pixels[y * pixelSize + x] = Color.Lerp(snakeBodyColor, Color.white, 0.15f);
            }
            else
            {
                pixels[y * pixelSize + x] = Color.clear;
            }
        }
    }

    tex.SetPixels(pixels);
    tex.Apply();
    File.WriteAllBytes(path + "SnakeBodyStraight.png", tex.EncodeToPNG());
    Object.DestroyImmediate(tex);
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Add GenerateBodyCorner method**

Insert after GenerateBodyStraight:

```csharp
private void GenerateBodyCorner(string path)
{
    Texture2D tex = CreateTexture(pixelSize, pixelSize);
    Color[] pixels = new Color[pixelSize * pixelSize];

    int half = pixelSize / 2;
    float bodyHalfW = pixelSize * 0.22f;     // pipe half-width
    float outerR = half * 0.85f;              // outer arc radius
    float innerR = outerR - bodyHalfW * 2f;   // inner arc radius

    // Corner center: bottom-left of the cell (where the two straight pipes meet)
    float cornerCX = -half * 0.15f;
    float cornerCY = -half * 0.15f;

    for (int y = 0; y < pixelSize; y++)
    {
        for (int x = 0; x < pixelSize; x++)
        {
            float cx = x - half - cornerCX;
            float cy = y - half - cornerCY;
            float dist = Mathf.Sqrt(cx * cx + cy * cy);

            // Inside the quarter-annulus (top-right quadrant)
            bool inPipe = (cx >= -1f && cy >= -1f) && (dist >= innerR && dist <= outerR);

            if (inPipe)
            {
                pixels[y * pixelSize + x] = snakeBodyColor;

                // Body pattern
                float t = Mathf.Atan2(cy, cx); // 0 to PI/2
                float patternIdx = Mathf.Floor(t * 6f / Mathf.PI);
                if ((int)patternIdx % 2 == 0)
                    pixels[y * pixelSize + x] = Color.Lerp(snakeBodyColor, snakeBodyPatternColor, 0.3f);
            }
            else
            {
                pixels[y * pixelSize + x] = Color.clear;
            }
        }
    }

    tex.SetPixels(pixels);
    tex.Apply();
    File.WriteAllBytes(path + "SnakeBodyCorner.png", tex.EncodeToPNG());
    Object.DestroyImmediate(tex);
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Add GenerateSnakeTail method**

Insert after GenerateBodyCorner:

```csharp
private void GenerateSnakeTail(string path)
{
    Texture2D tex = CreateTexture(pixelSize, pixelSize);
    Color[] pixels = new Color[pixelSize * pixelSize];

    int half = pixelSize / 2;
    float tailBaseHalfH = pixelSize * 0.25f;  // half height at base (left side)
    float tailTipX = half * 0.85f;             // tip x position (right side)

    for (int y = 0; y < pixelSize; y++)
    {
        for (int x = 0; x < pixelSize; x++)
        {
            float cx = x - half;
            float cy = y - half;

            // Tapering tail: at x=-half, height=tailBaseHalfH; at x=tailTipX, height=0
            float maxH = Mathf.Lerp(tailBaseHalfH, 0f, (cx + half) / (tailTipX + half));
            if (cx >= -half && cx <= tailTipX && Mathf.Abs(cy) <= maxH)
            {
                pixels[y * pixelSize + x] = snakeBodyColor;

                // Subtle taper detail lines
                if ((int)(cy * 3f / Mathf.Max(0.01f, maxH)) % 2 == 0 && cx < tailTipX - 4f)
                    pixels[y * pixelSize + x] = Color.Lerp(snakeBodyColor, snakeBodyPatternColor, 0.2f);
            }
            else
            {
                pixels[y * pixelSize + x] = Color.clear;
            }
        }
    }

    tex.SetPixels(pixels);
    tex.Apply();
    File.WriteAllBytes(path + "SnakeTail.png", tex.EncodeToPNG());
    Object.DestroyImmediate(tex);
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Add helper methods before UpdateSegmentVisuals**

Insert after the `MoveSnake()` method, before `Grow()`:

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Update all segment sprites and rotations based on directional connectivity.
/// </summary>
private void UpdateSegmentVisuals()
{
    if (segments.Count == 0) return;

    // Head: faces the movement direction
    segments[0].SetSprite(headSprite);
    segments[0].SetRotation(DirectionToAngle(movement.CurrentDirection));

    // Tail (if more than 1 segment): faces toward body[count-2]
    if (segments.Count >= 2)
    {
        int tailIdx = segments.Count - 1;
        Vector2Int tailDir = segments[tailIdx - 1].GridPosition - segments[tailIdx].GridPosition;
        segments[tailIdx].SetSprite(tailSprite);
        segments[tailIdx].SetRotation(DirectionToAngle(tailDir));
    }

    // Body segments (indices 1..count-2): determine straight or corner
    for (int i = 1; i < segments.Count - 1; i++)
    {
        Vector2Int dirToHead = segments[i - 1].GridPosition - segments[i].GridPosition;
        Vector2Int dirToTail = segments[i + 1].GridPosition - segments[i].GridPosition;

        if (dirToHead == -dirToTail)
        {
            // Straight: two neighbors are on the same line
            segments[i].SetSprite(bodyStraightSprite);
            segments[i].SetRotation(GetStraightAngle(dirToHead));
        }
        else
        {
            // Corner: two neighbors are perpendicular
            segments[i].SetSprite(bodyCornerSprite);
            segments[i].SetRotation(GetCornerAngle(dirToHead, dirToTail));
        }
    }
}

private float DirectionToAngle(Vector2Int dir)
{
    if (dir == Vector2Int.right)  return 0f;
    if (dir == Vector2Int.up)     return 90f;
    if (dir == Vector2Int.left)   return 180f;
    if (dir == Vector2Int.down)   return 270f;
    return 0f;
}

private float GetStraightAngle(Vector2Int dir)
{
    // Horizontal if dir has x component, vertical if y component
    return (dir.x != 0) ? 0f : 90f;
}

private float GetCornerAngle(Vector2Int d1, Vector2Int d2)
{
    Vector2Int sum = d1 + d2;
    // sum maps to the quadrant of the corner
    if (sum.x > 0 && sum.y > 0)  return 0f;    // top-right
    if (sum.x < 0 && sum.y > 0)  return 90f;   // top-left
    if (sum.x < 0 && sum.y < 0)  return 180f;  // bottom-left
    if (sum.x > 0 && sum.y < 0)  return 270f;  // bottom-right
    return 0f;
}
```
